limit_order_match_in_progress.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed in _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade check during limit order matching

matched_base_amount.meaning: the matched base amount for the limit order match
matched_base_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade check during limit order matching

matched_quote_amount.meaning: the matched quote amount for the limit order match
matched_quote_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade check during limit order matching

matched_base_is_power_of_two.meaning: the matched base amount is a power-of-two value 2^k
matched_base_is_power_of_two.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade check during limit order matching

amounts_have_disjoint_bits.meaning: the two matched amounts have no overlapping 1-bits (bitwise AND is zero)
amounts_have_disjoint_bits.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade check during limit order matching

limit_order_matching_completes.meaning: the legitimate limit order matching completes without reverting
limit_order_matching_completes.checkpoint: after the zero-cost trade check during limit order matching

assumptions: The matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities at the checkpoint before the zero-cost trade check.
The disjoint-bit condition is represented as a report-grounded Boolean because the report gives only examples, not a numeric definition.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the power-of-two exponent k or a concrete bound for the disjoint-bit condition beyond examples; represented as grounded Booleans.
Report does not specify whether matched amounts are computed before or during the checked action; checkpoint is taken as before the zero-cost trade check.

limitations: The impact text describes the affected scope (all limit order matching, fill orders unaffected) rather than an explicit revert event; the completion obligation is the report-supported desired outcome for legitimate matches.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering limit order matching are not stated and are not encoded.
